info.title: Atlassian MCP V2
info.description: Connects Copilot Studio to the Atlassian MCP server (v2) for Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, Bitbucket Cloud, Loom, Goals, Projects, Teams and Teamwork Graph. Every call runs as the signed-in user, with that user's Atlassian permissions.

post.description: Sends JSON-RPC 2.0 requests to the Atlassian MCP server (v2). The server lists a small set of primary tools and reaches the rest through discover and the executeRead, executeWrite and executeDestructive tools.

scopes.offline_access: Keep you signed in by refreshing the access token.
scopes.read:jira:agent-interface: Read Jira work items, spaces, boards, sprints and versions.
scopes.search:jira:agent-interface: Search Jira work items with JQL.
scopes.write:jira:agent-interface: Create and update Jira work items, comments, worklogs and links.
scopes.read:confluence:agent-interface: Read Confluence pages, spaces, comments and attachments.
scopes.write:confluence:agent-interface: Create and update Confluence pages and comments.
scopes.read:bitbucket:agent-interface: Read Bitbucket Cloud repositories, pull requests and pipelines.
